statement: An entity that suspects an eligible data breach must carry out a reasonable and expeditious assessment and take all reasonable steps to complete it within 30 days; once there are reasonable grounds to believe an eligible data breach occurred, the entity must prepare a statement, give it to the Information Commissioner as soon as practicable, and notify the contents to the affected or at-risk individuals (or publish the statement where individual notice is impracticable).
caveat: The scheme applies to APP entities, so small business operators under the section 6D threshold are generally outside it unless an exclusion applies. Remedial-action exceptions in sections 26WF and 26WJ can take a breach outside the scheme; the OAIC's online form is the reporting channel.
